nodes.rationale: PathIsoladoGuard::with_only_codex_instalado always wrote codex.exe even off Windows, hiding the fake binary from catalog::command_exists_in_dir on Linux; fixed with cfg!(windows) outside this skill, not yet re-proven in real CI.

nodes.label: Bug found and fixed: release.yml:135 git add referenced nonexistent Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock paths
nodes.rationale: The version moved to the workspace root Cargo.toml but T6's git add still referenced the reference repo's src-tauri path, which under set -euo pipefail would abort the prepare job before any commit/tag.
nodes.norm_label: bug found and fixed: release.yml:135 git add referenced nonexistent cargo.toml/cargo.lock paths

nodes.label: Bug found and fixed: make-portable.mjs default binary path pointed to wrong build output
nodes.rationale: defaultBinaryPath() resolved to src-tauri/target/release/... but the Cargo workspace builds to <root>/target/release/; release.yml called the script without --binary, so it would have hit the broken default in production.
nodes.norm_label: bug found and fixed: make-portable.mjs default binary path pointed to wrong build output

nodes.label: Blocked/stationed: mcp-task-server/T9 cannot start IpcServer without touching out-of-scope files
nodes.rationale: IpcServer::for_app requires Arc-wrapped TerminalManager/Mutex<Db>/TerminalMetaService, but lib.rs manages them as bare types consumed by commands/terminal.rs and update/check.rs, outside T9's authorized file list — an architecture decision, not an ambiguity.
nodes.norm_label: blocked/stationed: mcp-task-server/t9 cannot start ipcserver without touching out-of-scope files

nodes.label: Traceability Marker (SPEC: comment convention)
nodes.rationale: Every file created/edited to implement a requirement carries a `// SPEC: <feature> (<IDs>)` comment before imports, so implementation traces back to a spec requirement ID. IDs must be real, per-feature prefixes already defined in .specs/features/<name>/spec.md; inventing an ID is forbidden. Verified via `grep -rn "SPEC:" src/ src-tauri/src/`.

nodes.label: Wave sequencing rationale (shared file territory)
nodes.rationale: lib.rs, App.tsx, TerminalHeader.tsx and commands/terminal.rs are shared territory touched by multiple tasks across features (multi-terminal/T14, T16; agent-selection/T5; settings-shell/T1; terminal-statuses/T5). To avoid concurrent-edit conflicts, tasks touching the same file are serialized into different execution waves instead of running in parallel.

nodes.label: cargo build --workspace redundancy (corrected gate description)
nodes.rationale: The Cargo workspace has no default-members restriction, so plain `cargo build` already compiles both src-tauri and crates/swarmdeck-mcp; `--workspace` is valid but redundant, not required. Triage 007 found the run-006 claim (that --workspace was needed) false via `cargo metadata` and corrected AGENTS.md's Build & test table.

nodes.label: ACL capabilities gap (kanban/settings windows)
nodes.rationale: src-tauri/capabilities/default.json only lists "windows": ["main"], so neither the kanban window nor the new settings window appear in the capability. Under Tauri 2 ACL this suggests no invoke() call from those windows would be permitted at runtime, which would block task-kanban/T7 (invoke('task_delete')/invoke('task_send')) and all of settings-shell/T2 navigation. Not fixed in run 007 — no queued task authorized editing capabilities/default.json for this purpose; flagged for the next spec-triage with priority, since if confirmed it is a real bug blocking two whole windows.

nodes.label: TerminalId integration gap (rename UI has no real path)
nodes.rationale: The real TerminalId returned by pty_spawn only exists today as a local variable inside TerminalPane.tsx; it never propagates up to App.tsx nor down into TerminalHeader.tsx. So even though the manual-rename UI (multi-terminal/T16) and the terminal_set_title command are complete and compile, there is no real end-to-end path to exercise them today. Same gap class that originated task T12; needs a future task wiring TerminalPane -> App.tsx -> TerminalHeader.
nodes.norm_label: terminalid integration gap (rename ui has no real path)

nodes.label: task-kanban/T8 blocked — architecture decision needed
nodes.rationale: The only task-creation path (tasks::service::create) requires a TerminalContext and derives project_id from cwd — it does not accept an explicit project. Three options were surfaced: (1) expand T8 to add task_create to the backend plus decide manual terminal_id semantics; (2) split into a backend task and a UI task; (3) reduce this round's criterion (no project selector) with an explicit AD admitting the reduction. Marked ⛔ NEEDS-DECISION in task-kanban/tasks.md; no file was touched by the attempt.
